newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MP SAYS NATO-RUSSIA DEAL GOOD FOR FINLAND.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MP SAYS NATO-RUSSIA DEAL GOOD FOR FINLAND.

text.p: The new security agreement between Russia and NATO will have a favourable effect on Finland's security policy environment, a senior Finnish member of parliament said on Tuesday.

"To my understanding, the now signed agreement between NATO and Russia will affect Finland's security policy environment favourably," Markus Aaltonen, chairman of parliament's foreign affairs committee, told the legislature according to the text of a prepared speech.
He spoke during a debate on a government report on security policy and defence.
Aaltonen referred to the signing on Tuesday by Russian and NATO leaders of the "Founding Act" of a new partnership for security in Europe at a ceremony in Paris.

The Founding Act on Mutual Relations is designed to bind Russia into efforts to create a new European security order and ease the 16-nation alliance's eastward expansion by admitting some of Moscow's former communist allies.
